name: branding-indigo-yellow-hanging-colour-tag-palette
title: Indigo and Yellow Hanging Colour Tags
whatItIs: A pale lavender canvas with four tilted, stepped colour tabs (deep indigo, periwinkle, warm yellow, white) hanging from dashed curved lines converging at the top, each tab labelled with a vertical hex code.
whatItMeans: Dashed strings make the swatches look like hanging tags, and the descending heights create a graphic skyline of colour.
techniques: Swatches suspended from converging dashed lines
Hex codes rotated 90 degrees down each tab
Text colour chosen per swatch for contrast
Slight tilt of tab tops for movement

vocabulary.definition: A colour sample drawn as if suspended by a line.
Text rotated to read top to bottom.
Swatches of different heights forming a silhouette.
